hero.title: Building Identity and Authorization Security for the AI Era
hero.subtitle: Kakr Labs is building the foundational trust infrastructure for humans, AI agents, and enterprises in the agentic future.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: We founded Kakr Labs because legacy security models — passwords, OTPs, centralized identity providers, and secret-based APIs — continue to fail at massive scale. Phishing, SIM-swaps, data breaches, and insecure AI delegation create enormous risk and friction.
story.p2: The solution isn't another layer on top of existing enterprise systems. It's replacing fragile, probabilistic trust with cryptographically verifiable authorization evidence. That's why we built PTERI — a unified Privacy Trust Engine powered by Litecoin Proof-of-Work and cryptographic verification.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.headline: Deliver true zero-custody, verifiable authority at the moment of every action.
mission.description: No shared secrets. No central honeypots. No assumptions. Just mathematically provable trust that scales from individual users to global enterprises.
